- F1 (#11466, V1) forked a second time (ACCEPT on #11466, 2026-10-02T22:28Z). V1 holds on PR #11512 (a draft, kept), but its head is red on 8 dashboard lines and 2 doc blocks, all outside its surface. It is `pm:blocked` behind three preparation cards filed then:

  - #11514: the dashboard producers name declared types, plus #11483's TS-face closure (in flight on PR #11524; rescoped after its dialect premise was measured false: the object-metric producer moved to decision card #11525, and Q2 A, the spec's `type` default, joined);
